sentence: This project builds a virtual reality training system that infers pilot mental states and adapts task demands to improve learning.
This project builds sensors that detect RNA molecules using a DNA strand attached to metal nanoparticles whose signal changes when the strand binds its target.
This project tries to find out what drove a large anomaly of cold, fresh water that swept across the Northwest Atlantic shelf and slope.
This project builds deep neural networks that process information encoded in light on a photonic chip.
This project builds a way to pull rules out of Internet of Things cybersecurity laws and store them so companies can check their privacy policies.
This project builds a way to simulate how a few particles interact and scatter on quantum computers.
This project studies how tomato plants control where and when they make acylsugars, which are sticky chemicals that protect against pests.
This project builds security methods that protect messages between connected vehicles from attacks by quantum computers.
This project studies how small changes in microtubule growth cause errors in chromosome segregation during cell division.
This project gets an X-ray diffraction system for studying the structure of many kinds of materials.
This project updates a set of online tools that let people analyze DNA sequences on a smartphone.
This project builds an implantable device powered by ultrasound that makes oxygen, a cancer drug and light to treat cancer.
This project builds an open database of cryo-electron tomography images and computer tools for analyzing structures inside cells.
This project studies how viruses and their hosts interact, from proteins and cells to whole ecosystems, to predict how viruses emerge.
This project builds ways to explain machine learning decisions that stay secure, stay valid when models change, and use feedback from users.
This project uses machine learning to predict which groups of proteins bind together as complexes that work in cells.
This project studies how marine animals and their ecosystems are affected by global change such as climate change.
This project measures ground temperature at permafrost sites in Alaska, Siberia and the Canadian Arctic Archipelago to see how fast and where permafrost is warming.
